stories.title: Yogi Adityanath demands apology for 1990 firing
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has demanded an apology from those who opposed the Ram temple movement before they visit Ayodhya. Adityanath referenced the 1990 firing at karsevaks, stating that those who once opposed the movement are now seeking political mileage from it.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi challenges Amit Shah to arrange debate
stories.summary: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi has urged Union Home Minister Amit Shah to convince Prime Minister Narendra Modi to participate in an open debate regarding the Special Intensive Revision exercise. Gandhi invited the Prime Minister to choose any platform or time for the discussion.

stories.title: Sonia Gandhi calls Emergency a mistake
stories.summary: Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi has described the 1975 Emergency as a mistake, noting that Indira Gandhi eventually felt the same. In her memoir, Gandhi writes that keeping Sanjay Gandhi in check could have prevented much of the damage that followed the period.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav to skip contesting 2027 UP polls
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav announced he will not contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, focusing instead on statewide campaigning. Yadav cited his belief in auspicious signs, noting that he was a Lok Sabha MP when the party secured a majority in 2012.

stories.title: Amit Shah calls for NDA government in Punjab
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has asked voters in Punjab to support a National Democratic Alliance government. Speaking in Haryana, Shah criticised Rahul Gandhi for promising farmers a toy rattle regarding minimum support price guarantees, while highlighting crop procurement efforts in the neighbouring state.

stories.title: Indian Youth Congress suspends 200 members for rally absence
stories.summary: The Indian Youth Congress has suspended approximately 200 office-bearers for failing to attend the INDIA bloc rally in Delhi on 1 November. The disciplinary action, which may eventually cover 500 functionaries, follows a directive requiring local leaders to mobilise workers for the event.

stories.title: BJP criticises Sonia Gandhi over Babri mosque remarks
stories.summary: The BJP has accused the Congress of maintaining an anti-Ram stance following Sonia Gandhi's comments on the demolition of the Babri mosque. Party spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi claimed the Congress has limited its historical memory to Babar, contrasting this with Rajiv Gandhi's past campaign promises.

stories.title: Kiren Rijiju offers advice to Congress
stories.summary: Union minister Kiren Rijiju has offered what he described as friendly advice to the Congress, suggesting the party needs a matured Leader of the Opposition to avoid further electoral losses. Rijiju previously shared a seven-point list of suggestions for Rahul Gandhi to improve parliamentary performance.

stories.title: Sonia Gandhi says Indira regretted Emergency
stories.summary: In an upcoming memoir, Sonia Gandhi writes that the 1975 Emergency was a mistake and that Indira Gandhi eventually came to regret the decision. She also suggests that keeping Sanjay Gandhi in check could have prevented much of the damage caused during that period.

stories.title: Sonia Gandhi sidesteps nepotism questions
stories.summary: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi declined to address allegations of nepotism and the party's continued reliance on the Gandhi family during a recent interview. When asked why the party has not moved beyond its current leadership, she stated the question should be put to the party itself.

stories.title: Ex-Tech Mahindra executive killed in Faridabad
stories.summary: A 43-year-old software executive visiting from Singapore was shot dead by a neighbour in Faridabad on Friday. Police stated the suspect fired multiple rounds following a dispute over parking and a dog. The suspect was arrested the following day.

stories.title: Delhi records worst air quality in decade
stories.summary: Delhi experienced its most polluted festival eve in ten years as farm fires in Punjab and Haryana reached seasonal highs. With calm winds trapping pollutants, the city's air quality was 30 percent dirtier than the previous night before festival activities even began.

stories.title: IndiGo flight returns to Bengaluru after threat
stories.summary: A full emergency was declared at Bengaluru airport after a suspected hijack threat note was found in the washroom of a Lucknow-bound IndiGo flight. The aircraft returned to the airport, where safety protocols were initiated. The flight was diverted before reaching its destination.

stories.title: Death toll in Old Delhi building collapse reaches four
stories.summary: The death toll from the building collapse in Old Delhi's Chawri Bazar has risen to four after two more bodies were recovered from the debris. One victim has been identified as a resident of Bihar, while the second remains unidentified.

stories.title: Bengaluru cab driver arrested for seven murders
stories.summary: A 52-year-old cab driver has been arrested for the alleged murder of his wife and six of her family members. Police believe the killings occurred over a period of 15 to 20 days following a domestic dispute. The bodies were disposed of across Karnataka.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at South Delhi Kia showroom
stories.summary: A fire at a Kia showroom in South Delhi injured eight people on Friday, including two police personnel. Officials confirmed that 12 to 15 people were rescued from the building. All injured individuals were treated and subsequently discharged from the hospital.

stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Manipur opens first AI-enabled career hub
stories.summary: Manipur has launched an AI-enabled career intelligence hub at a girls school in Imphal. The facility aims to mould careers and marks a significant step toward integrating AI into the state education ecosystem. It was established under a local area development scheme for the northeastern region.

stories.title: ATMED and Anna University sign medical device MoU
stories.summary: The Association of Tamil Nadu Medical Device Industry and Anna University have signed an agreement to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and industrial requirements. The partnership covers student internships, technical training, research and product development to support the medical device sector in the state.

stories.title: University of Madras to renew AI lab partnership
stories.summary: The University of Madras will partner with Sutherland Global Services to establish an AI laboratory at its Department of Women Studies. The company will upgrade a previous allocation for a lab that was closed during the lockdown. The prior facility had seen its digital equipment destroyed.

stories.title: World Trade Center planned for Chengalpattu
stories.summary: GTB Developers has secured a licence to build a World Trade Center in Chengalpattu. The project is valued at 7,000 crore and is planned as an IT integrated township spanning up to 150 acres. Development is expected to occur in phases over the next ten years.

stories.title: Sivakasi fireworks industry overview
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. This report explores the people and industry behind the fireworks production in Sivakasi, India's fireworks capital, ahead of Deepavali celebrations. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu battery storage policy welcomed
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu Electricity Consumers Association has backed the state's new Battery Energy Storage System policy. The association noted that dependence on expensive short-term power purchases highlights a need for storage solutions. The policy targets 2.5 GW of battery storage capacity over the next three years.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu forms investment commission
stories.summary: The state government has constituted a 20-member Investment Promotion Commission headed by the Chief Secretary. The body aims to facilitate investments linked to free trade agreements and those from persons of Tamil origin living outside India. Multiple department secretaries will serve on the commission.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu government announces official transfers
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has reassigned several senior officials. C. Palani has been appointed Managing Director of the Tamil Nadu Road Development Company Limited, while K.M. Sarayu returns from leave to serve as Director of Town Panchayats. D. Ravichandran moves to the Department of Employment and Training.

stories.title: Document writers protest registration hub plans
stories.summary: Document writers across Tamil Nadu plan to halt registration work on November 10 and 11. The protest targets the state's move to implement Model Registration Hubs, which allow property and marriage registration outside local jurisdiction. About 5,000 writers in Coimbatore district are participating in the action.

stories.title: FSSAI seizes 3,280 tonnes of food products
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India seized 3,280 tonnes of non-compliant food products worth 82 crore during a recent inspection drive. The regulator cancelled 52 licences and suspended over 1,100 others. The drive focused on adulteration risks during the festive season.

stories.title: NGT issues notice over Tamirabharani fish threats
stories.summary: The National Green Tribunal has issued notices to the Tirunelveli Collector and five others regarding threats to endemic fish in the Tamirabharani River. The tribunal acted on reports of pollution and habitat loss. The notice requires responses from state and central pollution control boards.

stories.title: Delhi air quality reaches severe levels
stories.summary: Delhi recorded severe air quality on the morning of Diwali, with an Air Quality Index of 383. Nearly half of the city's monitoring stations reported severe conditions following firecracker use. The city woke up to a thick blanket of toxic haze.

stories.title: Goa CM seeks mining lease reopening
stories.summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has proposed reopening 153 iron ore mining leases in ecologically sensitive areas of the Western Ghats. He suggested a scientific assessment to identify eligible mineral resources for auction. The Chief Minister is seeking a solution from the union environment ministry.

stories.title: CAQM orders prosecution for dust mitigation failure
stories.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management has directed the Municipal Corporation of Gurugram to prosecute officials for failing to implement dust mitigation measures. The order follows reports of unattended construction dust and loose soil. The corporation had previously recommended disciplinary action against an executive engineer.

stories.title: Petrol pumps ordered to check for water
stories.summary: State-run oil marketing companies have mandated that petrol pumps check storage tanks for water every two to eight hours. The frequent testing is intended to protect the quality of 20 percent ethanol-blended petrol. Ethanol is known to absorb water from its surroundings.

stories.title: Oil companies challenge ethanol content claims
stories.summary: State-run oil companies have rejected claims by the Karnataka government that petrol sold in the state contained 26 to 31 percent ethanol. The companies maintained that their fuel meets the 20 percent limit and have requested independent verification of the state's testing methodology.

stories.title: Forest team assaulted in Rajasthan
stories.summary: A forest team from Madhya Pradesh was allegedly assaulted by villagers in Rajasthan while tracking a cheetah. The animal had reportedly killed a calf in the area. Police have registered a case against the villagers for assaulting public servants and intentional insult.

stories.title: Villagers protest after deer killed in Barmer
stories.summary: Two deer were allegedly killed by poachers in Rajasthan, with villagers reporting that one carcass was hung from a tree. The incident in the Dhanau police station area has triggered protests demanding the immediate arrest of those responsible. The investigation into the suspected poachers is ongoing.

stories.title: Japan earthquake injures dozens
stories.summary: A 5.7-magnitude earthquake struck Shizuoka Prefecture early Sunday, injuring dozens and disrupting transport services. The tremor shattered storefront windows and knocked items off shelves across the region. Authorities reported no deaths and issued no tsunami warning. The ground remains capable of movement.

stories.title: US military fires on commercial vessel
stories.summary: U.S. Central Command disabled a St. Kitts-flagged ship in the Gulf of Oman after it allegedly attempted to breach a naval blockade. The military stated the vessel ignored multiple warnings after visiting an Iranian port. The command has previously declined to confirm other recent strikes in the region.

stories.title: Six killed in Krakow market square shooting
stories.summary: A gunman drove into a busy market square in Krakow on Saturday, killing six people and wounding 15, including police officers. The perpetrator was shot and wounded by police during a gunfight. The regional government confirmed the death toll rose to six following the initial attack.

stories.title: Krakow shooting details
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. A gunman opened fire in a busy market square in Krakow on Saturday, injuring 15 people and killing six. The city, which hosts roughly 15 million tourists annually, is located about 250 kilometers from Warsaw. Police are investigating the motive.

stories.title: Iran distributes iodine tablets
stories.summary: Iran is distributing 180,000 iodine tablets as tensions rise regarding potential strikes on nuclear sites. The World Health Organisation notes that iodine can help manage radioactive exposure following nuclear accidents. The tablets are intended for use in the event of environmental contamination from radiation.

stories.title: UAE Coast Guard rescues 22 from burning ship
stories.summary: The UAE Coast Guard rescued 22 crew members after a fire broke out on a cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman. All rescued individuals are reported to be in stable condition. Specialised teams responded to the distress call to locate and reach the vessel.

stories.title: New Zealand election remains undecided
stories.summary: Preliminary projections show neither the National Party nor the Labour Party has secured a decisive mandate. Smaller parties have strengthened their positions, with the Green Party recording its best result. A right-leaning bloc is projected to hold 67 seats in the expanded 131-member parliament.

stories.title: Trump offers press secretary role to Dana White
stories.summary: Donald Trump has offered the position of White House press secretary to UFC boss Dana White, describing him as a violent fighter and warrior. Trump also requested that White bring several international fighters to serve as his assistants. The role was recently vacated.

stories.title: Dana White's background
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Dana White, born in Boston in 1969, has been offered the role of White House press secretary by Donald Trump. This follows the firing of Katie Zacharia, who held the position for less than a week earlier this month.

stories.title: Tesla to add Cybertruck shift
stories.summary: Tesla will add an extra shift to Cybertruck production to clear the order backlog before dismantling the line next year. Elon Musk stated the factory will shift resources toward the Cybercab. The company is currently pivoting its focus toward becoming an AI and robotics firm.

stories.title: Amazon to pay $309.5 million in refund settlement
stories.summary: A Washington State judge approved a $309.5 million settlement for customers who did not receive refunds for physical items purchased between 2017 and 2026. Eligible class members have until March 2027 to submit claims. Amazon previously maintained its return policy was sufficient.

stories.title: Helios Mid Cap Fund adjusts portfolio
stories.summary: The Helios Mid Cap Fund added shares of Aurobindo Pharma, Zetwerk, and PVR Inox to its portfolio in October. The fund also increased its stake in Paytm and the Multi Commodity Exchange of India. Investors continue to show interest in midcap funds with significant asset inflows.

stories.title: Divi's Laboratories reports revenue growth
stories.summary: Divi's Laboratories reported a 35.4 percent year-on-year rise in revenue to Rs 3,676 crore for the second quarter. The pharmaceutical company's consolidated total income reached Rs 3,770 crore. The firm noted a foreign exchange gain of Rs 24 crore for the period.

stories.title: Midterms impact Federal Reserve outlook
stories.summary: Recent election results may limit President Trump's influence over the Federal Reserve, potentially providing Chairman Kevin Warsh more freedom for his monetary agenda. Analysts suggest the shift in government spending and AI infrastructure could reshape the economic outlook. The Fed remains theoretically independent.

stories.title: Rising bond yields hit bank earnings
stories.summary: Rising government bond yields caused a 62 percent drop in average treasury income for Indian banks during the September quarter. Lenders faced mark-to-market losses on investment portfolios, leaving fewer opportunities to book profits. Banks now face the challenge of sourcing income elsewhere.

stories.title: India unlikely to restrict broken rice exports
stories.summary: India has no current plans to impose fresh restrictions on broken rice exports, relying on steady procurement to maintain domestic food security. The government lifted previous bans in March 2025. Despite international price surges, officials maintain that existing stocks are sufficient.

stories.title: Food costs dominate rural spending
stories.summary: Rural households allocated 53.5 percent of their monthly spending to food in September 2026, according to a NABARD survey. This share has remained stable since 2024, showing little structural change in consumption patterns. Inflation concerns continue to influence household sentiment.

stories.title: US mid-term results and the Iran war
stories.summary: President Trump lost control of the House and Senate in the US mid-terms. With Democrats now holding Congress, expectations are that the administration will shift toward a negotiated settlement in the Iran war. Crude oil prices are expected to ease if the conflict cools down.

stories.title: Eastern Pacific cyclone energy hits record high
stories.summary: El Niño has pushed accumulated cyclone energy in the eastern Pacific to its highest level since 1950. The 2026 season has already surpassed previous records. The weather has been busy.

stories.title: Wind advisory issued for Pacific Northwest
stories.summary: The National Weather Service has issued a wind advisory for Seattle, Bellingham and the San Juan Islands. Forecasters warn of 50 mph gusts and potential power outages as the strongest weather system of the season arrives. The region is currently bracing for the weekend.

stories.title: Measles outbreaks prompt epidemiological review
stories.summary: Public health experts are calling for a reassessment of measles epidemiology in Keralam as cases rise across multiple districts. The disease is now appearing in fully vaccinated individuals and infants. The state reported 824 confirmed and 1,681 probable cases as of November 6.

stories.title: Government to expand access to SMA medication
stories.summary: Health Minister K. Muraleedharan announced that the government will distribute the spinal muscular atrophy medicine Risdiplam through medical colleges in all districts. The initiative aims to decentralise care and provide relief to families. Previously, the medication was available only through limited channels.

stories.title: Shigella cases rise in Malappuram
stories.summary: Eight people have tested positive for Shigella in Malappuram, with five cases linked to a wedding feast. Around 80 attendees have reported symptoms of diarrhoea, and health officials have stepped up surveillance. A child is currently under special observation.

stories.title: Grant awarded to study parental grief in autism
stories.summary: The Child Development Centre in Thiruvananthapuram received a 35-lakh grant from the ICMR to study grief among parents of children with autism. The three-year project aims to develop a culturally relevant assessment tool through focus groups and interviews with families and professionals.

stories.title: Shigellosis cases reported at Kozhikode school
stories.summary: Three children from Meppayil Senior Basic School have tested positive for shigellosis after presenting with vomiting and fever. Over 100 people have sought medical treatment for similar symptoms in the area since Friday. Initial blood tests for the children had returned negative results.

stories.title: Maharashtra plans cochlear implant expansion
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government is planning to establish cochlear implant surgery facilities in municipal corporation hospitals across the state. The move aims to expand services currently limited to the Thane Municipal Corporation. The state intends to provide early detection and treatment for deaf patients.

stories.title: NMC warns students against fake medical colleges
stories.summary: The National Medical Commission has advised students to verify institutional approvals before paying fees. The warning follows a Supreme Court case involving a purported medical college operating from a farmhouse. Some institutions are reportedly offering courses without statutory recognition or valid documents.

stories.title: Postgraduate doctors leaving premier institutes
stories.summary: RTI data shows postgraduate doctors are resigning from residency programmes at institutions including AIIMS and JIPMER. AIIMS Delhi reported 34 junior resident departures in 2025. While some institutes lack consolidated stress data, representatives suggest departures continue despite the competitive nature of the positions.

stories.title: Supreme Court denies bail to doctor in cough syrup case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court refused bail to paediatrician Praveen Soni, who was arrested for allegedly prescribing Coldrif cough syrup linked to the deaths of 26 children in Madhya Pradesh. The court observed that the case was too serious to warrant his release at this stage.

stories.title: IAF lands heavy-lift aircraft at high-altitude airbase
stories.summary: An Indian Air Force IL-76MD aircraft landed at the 13,629-foot Mudh-Nyoma airbase in Ladakh, marking the highest-altitude landing for the aircraft type. The airbase was inaugurated last year and sits 23km from the Line of Actual Control. The feat reinforces India's strategic airlift capability.

stories.title: India and EU conclude research programme negotiations
stories.summary: India and the European Union have finished negotiations for India's association with the 93.5-billion-euro Horizon Europe research programme. The agreement is expected to open new funding and collaboration opportunities for Indian organisations. The deal follows efforts to strengthen scientific cooperation between the two sides.

stories.title: India and EU finalise scientific cooperation deal
stories.summary: India and the European Union have concluded negotiations for association with the 93.5-billion-euro Horizon Europe research programme. Once procedures are complete, Indian organisations will be able to receive direct funding. The agreement is a step toward strengthening scientific ties between the two regions.

stories.title: ISRO Chairman meets Tamil Nadu Chief Minister
stories.summary: ISRO Chairman V. Narayanan met with Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay at the Secretariat in Chennai on Friday. The meeting lasted over 30 minutes and included representatives from NABARD. The full details of the discussion were not disclosed.

stories.title: Climate scientist P.V. Joseph dies at 94
stories.summary: Noted climate scientist P.V. Joseph passed away at 94. A former director of the IMD Meteorological Training School, he was known for discovering the low-level monsoon jetstream. He conducted extensive research on monsoon onset and Rossby waves throughout his career.

stories.title: Commission rejects RTI pleas regarding ex-girlfriend
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu Information Commission rejected 97 RTI applications filed by a man asking about his former girlfriend's relationship status. The commissioner warned the applicant that he could be sent for medical counselling if he continued filing what were described as mindless requests.

stories.title: Diwali sales projected to reach $16 billion
stories.summary: India's online sales during the run-up to Diwali are expected to rise 25 percent to as much as $16 billion this year, according to Redseer Strategy Consultants. This marks the fastest growth in five years. The festival remains a significant driver for both retail and hosting businesses.

stories.title: India celebrates Diwali 2026
stories.summary: Families across India are celebrating Diwali today, November 8, with prayers and festive decorations. The occasion marks the triumph of light over darkness and serves as a time for welcoming prosperity. Digital platforms are currently hosting over 110 messages and greetings for users to share with others.

stories.title: Regional customs mark Diwali celebrations
stories.summary: Diwali celebrations are underway across India, featuring diverse traditions from Ayodhya's riverbank diyas to Goa's Narkasur effigies. The five-day festival is supported by large-scale civic preparations and special railway services. The events continue to highlight regional variations of the same message regarding the triumph of light over darkness.

stories.title: The debate over Indian founders and the US
stories.summary: Venture investor Deedy Das recently argued that smart Indian founders continue to build in the US due to superior economic incentives. He cited twenty AI companies with Indian-born founders as evidence. The argument suggests that staying in India is largely a matter of family or visa constraints.

stories.title: Mohammed Shami and the mechanics of fast bowling
stories.summary: Mohammed Shami's bowling success is attributed to his wrist position, explosive energy and strength built through solitary practice in Amroha. Observers note that his ability to control the ball remains difficult to replicate through coaching manuals alone. Rhythm is apparently a product of repetition and matchplay.

stories.title: Mookuthi Amman 2 review
stories.summary: The film Mookuthi Amman 2 features Nayanthara as a deity with divine powers. While the movie attempts to engage with mythological themes familiar to millennial audiences, the review suggests that the narrative struggles to overcome the limitations of its own filmmaking.

stories.title: Suriya stars in Jithu Madhavan's Scene
stories.summary: Director Jithu Madhavan's dark comedy Scene has been released for the Diwali holiday. The film is described as an engaging experience, with early screenings drawing enthusiastic responses from audiences. The lead performance is being positioned as a potential third consecutive hit for the actor in 2026.

stories.title: Disco movie review
stories.summary: Ullas Chemban's film Disco features mafia members who dress in elaborate costumes, including Santa Claus outfits and goat masks, before executing hits. The film relies on generic gangster tropes to drive its narrative. The costume department appears to have been the most active part of the production.
